verdict:
WATCH, NO ORDER - the demand narrative is refuted on primary-verified numbers, and what stands between this name and a starter is one unresolvable disclosure gap plus a hard-money capital structure, both SIZE questions, not kills.

THE SCREEN FIRED ON GARBAGE AND ACCIDENTALLY FOUND SOMETHING. The -81.6% dd52 is a de-SPAC float-normalization artifact with an UNSTABLE denominator - the pack says hi52 $20.385, stockanalysis says $60.00, macrotrends says $16.00 close-ATH - and roughly half the per-share decline is the 87% share-count expansion, not de-rating (cap -49% vs price -73%). Neither bench closed the trigger-integrity question; it goes to the screen-defect ledger. Underneath the broken trigger: deferred revenue $82.5M, +107% YoY (primary-verified by both benches independently), Guild members +99% to 2.85M, Guild revenue +94%, Q2 total revenue +27.5% THROUGH a -91% theatrical quarter, OCF +$18.8M (operational, though ~$16.0M of it is the deferred-revenue build - steady-state roughly breakeven, red's honest caveat kept), and S&M leverage improving (52.8% of Guild revenue vs 71.6%). A subscriber-demand collapse cannot coexist with prepaid deferred revenue doubling. DAMAGE-ABSENT survives both benches.

WHAT KEEPS IT FROM BEING A BUY. (1) The only growing core segment's marginal economics are UNAUDITABLE: the filmmaker revenue-split and churn are simply not disclosed - red's most important sizing finding, sustained. The triage's ~$1.1M Guild contribution arithmetic is a construction from consolidated GM, not a disclosure. Cap any entry size on this opacity. (2) The capital structure is hard-money: $78.0M gross at 10-15%, stockholders' deficit -$29.3M, April rescue equity at $2.10, and the 12-month liquidity sentence leans on 'the ability to sell its digital assets if necessary' - 303.1 BTC worth $17.7M, down from $26.5M, whose mark-to-market losses are excluded from the marketed adj-EBITDA. Red's kg candidate on that pattern is a keeper. (3) A dated ~7% dilution pipeline: the S-4 (Tuttle Twins/Toothy Cow, ~10.15M shares) with a 10/31 contractual deadline. (4) The external demand funnel reads DECAYING (consumer_product_heat 39.1) - but blue's confound is right: brand heat for a slate-driven studio mechanically decays in a no-release quarter; keep it as a tripwire, discount it as a timing kill. The app_review_velocity connector - the one channel that would read the Guild funnel directly - never resolved the Angel app listing. That unresolved detector is the BINDING pre-entry gate.

INSIDERS AND FLOW: the two 8/12 13D/As are estate-planning transfers, and the same principals bought open-market two days later (Sarowitz ~$570k across two days, CEO Harmon ~$125K) - signaling-sized against $70M+ stakes, but directionally consistent with the DAMAGE-ABSENT read. Discovery state: NOT undiscovered (5-12 analysts, Moderate/Strong Buy consensus) - the market is discounting items 1-3, not the consumer; there is no 'nobody looked' edge here, which is exactly why the disposition is WATCH rather than starter.

GATE RULING: the existing ledger gate (alert_below 2.1 - the April offering clearing price; 're-court, do not buy') is KEPT as written - a re-test of the rescue-equity print would contradict the operational-turn read and must trigger a court, not a fill. ANGX has no exogenous commodity carrier; its idiosyncratic risk (Guild economics, hard-money paper) is exactly what a re-test would evidence, so the gate is thesis-consistent as a re-court trigger.
blue_ruling: PARTIALLY OVERTURNED: blue sustained red's genuinely decisive work - the content-amortization bear leg resolving to a $5.4M immaterial in one fetch (half the triage's court mandate was moot at filing), the corrected capital-structure numbers (debt $78.0M not $102.3M; deficit -$29.3M not -$41.5M - the triage's secondary-parse errors ran BEARISH), the BTC-backstopped liquidity finding, and the unresolvable-Guild-margin disclosure gap. Blue overturned red's flagship segment-damage kill: theatrical -48.5% H1 YoY is a base effect against a comp containing The King of Kings, Angel's second-highest-grossing film ever (~93% of H1'26's entire theatrical line in its opening stretch), landing in a quarter with no wide release. I checked the correction's load-bearing external fact against the public record rather than either bench's citation: The King of Kings released April 2025 with a ~$19M opening weekend, the faith-based-animation record, second-highest Angel gross behind Sound of Freedom - blue's characterization holds. The III precedent (a killer fact that is itself an artifact) fired on red exactly as the template warns.
reopen_gates: COVERAGE (BINDING pre-entry gate, both benches + adjudicator agree): resolve the Angel Studios app listing and run app_review_velocity. Flat-or-rising review velocity into Q3 = the Guild funnel corroborated externally -> starter tranche eligible, size capped small on the margin-opacity finding, RP-labeled carry-vs-edge. Collapsing velocity = the DECAYING heat signal was real, not a slate confound -> kill the entry case.

EVENT (dated, 10/31 contractual deadline): the S-4 shareholder vote/close on the Tuttle Twins and Toothy Cow mergers (~10.15M shares, ~7%) - preferably enter only after this dilution overhang clears; a deal break or renegotiation is its own information.
DATA: Q3 deferred revenue builds sequentially WITHOUT an annual-price-increase confound (red's mind-change condition c, adopted) - the one internal metric that keeps the demand refutation live.

DATA: any disclosure of the Guild filmmaker revenue-split or cohort churn (proxy, investor day, S-4 amendment) - resolves the unauditable-margin finding in either direction and is the difference between a capped starter and a real position.
DATA: content-licensing counterparty quality on the +176% line ($9.2M to $25.3M H1) - blue's uninvestigated third leg; lumpy, minimum-guarantee terms unverified; one fetch at the next 10-Q.
PRICE (existing ledger gate, kept): alert_below 2.10 = the April rescue-equity clearing price - a re-test contradicts the operational turn; RE-COURT, DO NOT BUY, exactly as the gate_basis says.
TRIPWIRE (kept, discounted): consumer_product_heat re-read at the next wide-release window - if heat stays DECAYING through an active slate quarter, the confound excuse expires.
